title: richetia hopeifolia
intro: Richetia hopeifolia, commonly known as Hopea, is a plant species within the family Dipterocarpaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as fever, headache, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Richetia hopeifolia are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exert anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The plant's bioactive constituents contribute to its therapeutic potential, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
